decision: Use the existing Universal Plugin Socket for AVF capability probing; do not put native probing logic in Stabilize core and do not create a second orchestrator.

plugin_adapter.responsibility: Read Android host feature/API/capability/permission state and normalize it to the AVF capability-probe contract. No workflow ownership, no acquisition, no provider rewriting.

plugin_spec.name: android_avf_adapter
plugin_spec.activation_rule: Remain disabled until explicit factory + target-host test + evidence pass MountGuard.

integration_validation.responsibility: Validate normalized probe result and map Requirement → Task → Artifact → Evidence → Validation; prevent COMPLETE when guest_boot_gate is not PASS for an AVF acceptance claim.

core_boundary.rule: Core consumes validated capability state for backend selection/lifecycle only. It must not implement Android API probing or duplicate plugin orchestration.

tests_required_before_enable: API<34 or feature absent -> fail-closed capability result
guest boot NOT_RUN never becomes PASS
fallback selection never becomes AVF PASS
plugin remains enabled=False until factory and real test evidence exist
integration finalization rejects AVF COMPLETE without guest boot evidence

ownership.runtime_mutation: coordinator or explicitly assigned code owner
ownership.workflow_owner: Stabilize CORE remains the only workflow owner

next_action: Coordinator may authorize runtime mutation using this exact handoff. Until then S2 continues CI/debate/read-only validation.
